sentences.zh: 而且，罗曼，你还记得这个吗？

sentences.zh: 你可以沿着它走，跟随密西西比河的路径。

sentences.zh: 绝对值得一看。

sentences.en: And, Roman, do you remember this?
sentences.zh: 我看到了。

sentences.en: You could sort of walk along it and follow the path of the Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 它还在那里。

sentences.en: It's totally worth checking out.
sentences.zh: 当然，泥岛有河流博物馆，这是一个致力于孟菲斯市的博物馆。

sentences.en: I saw it.
sentences.zh: 而且，罗曼，我在来孟菲斯之前就知道这个。

sentences.en: It's still there.
sentences.zh: 我想你能猜到为什么。

sentences.en: And, of course, Mud Island has the River Museum, which was this museum dedicated to the city of Memphis.
sentences.zh: 因为它来自一部你可能作为孟菲斯人看过的电影。

sentences.en: And, Roman, I knew about this before I came to Memphis.
sentences.zh: 哦，你是说《糖衣陷阱》。

sentences.en: I think you can guess why.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because it's from a movie that you have probably seen as someone who is from Memphis.
sentences.zh: 是《糖衣陷阱》。

sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，孟菲斯河博物馆因参观人数过少，已于2018年关闭。

sentences.en: It's next to this unused building that has more than 30,000 square feet of space.
sentences.zh: 它就在这栋闲置建筑的旁边，建筑面积超过3万平方英尺。

sentences.en: But do they have any plans to do anything with it?
sentences.zh: 但他们有计划利用它做点什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's funny because, remember, we talked about the pyramid as this case of adaptive reuse.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为别忘了，我们之前讨论过金字塔作为适应性再利用案例的情况。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like, it was an arena and then it became a Bass Pro.
sentences.zh: 比如，它曾经是一个竞技场，后来变成了巴斯户外运动用品店（Bass Pro）。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And throughout Memphis, there are a lot of cool projects like this, I'm noticing.
sentences.zh: 我注意到，在整个孟菲斯，有很多像这样的酷项目。

sentences.en: A lot of good adaptive reuse that's been happening.
sentences.zh: 有很多很棒的适应性再利用项目正在进行中。

sentences.en: So, there's this old Sears warehouse, which has become this massive community center.
sentences.zh: 比如，有一个旧西尔斯仓库，已经变成了一个大型社区中心。

sentences.en: There's lots of old office buildings downtown that have been converted into housing.
sentences.zh: 市中心有很多旧办公楼被改造成了住宅。

sentences.en: And with the River Museum, there are people recently who've moved in and are starting to clean it up.
sentences.zh: 至于河博物馆，最近有人搬了进去，开始清理它。

sentences.en: Drywall's been replaced.
sentences.zh: 干墙已经更换了。

sentences.en: The walls have been painted.
sentences.zh: 墙壁也粉刷过了。

sentences.en: But there's still a lot of junk.
sentences.zh: 但里面还是有很多垃圾。

sentences.en: So, that's Marvin Stockwell.
sentences.zh: 那位就是马文·斯托克韦尔（Marvin Stockwell）。

sentences.en: He's leading the redevelopment project of the Old River Museum.
sentences.zh: 他正在领导旧河博物馆的重建项目。

sentences.en: We've been given access to an immersive by design museum space that snakes back in on itself.
sentences.zh: 我们获准进入了一个沉浸式设计的博物馆空间，它蜿蜒曲折，内部结构复杂。

sentences.en: It's 33,000 square feet.
sentences.zh: 它有3.3万平方英尺大。

sentences.en: And there are two full-size boats in there.
sentences.zh: 里面还有两艘全尺寸的船。

sentences.en: So, we were given a space that, like, if you're a commercial developer, you're like, the hell are we going to do with this space?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们面对的是这样一个空间，如果你是个商业开发商，你会想：我们到底要拿这个空间怎么办？

sentences.en: But you turn it over to artists and they're like, I'll tell you what we're going to do with it, right?
sentences.zh: 但如果你把它交给艺术家，他们会说：我来告诉你我们要拿它做什么，对吧？

sentences.en: So, today, Marvin's working with artists and designers and video game developers.
sentences.zh: 所以，今天，马文正在与艺术家、设计师和电子游戏开发者合作。

sentences.en: And they're turning it into this immersive experience.
sentences.zh: 他们正在把它变成一种沉浸式体验。

sentences.en: Like, there's going to be big video screens and, like, a sci-fi plot and kind of this D&D-like game you can play.
sentences.zh: 比如，会有巨大的视频屏幕，还有科幻情节，以及一种类似《龙与地下城》的游戏可以玩。

sentences.en: So, Catherine Hicks, she's one of the developers on the project.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·希克斯（Catherine Hicks）是该项目的开发人员之一。

sentences.en: And here's how she described it to me.
sentences.zh: 她是这样向我描述的。

sentences.en: Think of the Millennium Falcon ride in Star Wars, but more observation deck style.
sentences.zh: 想象一下《星球大战》里的千年隼号游乐设施，但更偏向观景台风格。

sentences.en: So, the look and feel will kind of be like this.
sentences.zh: 所以，外观和感觉大概会是这样。

sentences.en: Very steampunky, very, like, 20,000 leagues under the sea.
sentences.zh: 非常有蒸汽朋克风格，非常像《海底两万里》那种感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 我的天，那太棒了。

sentences.en: It sounds incredibly ambitious.
sentences.zh: 听起来非常有野心。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And, I mean, there's a huge renovation happening in the space right now.
sentences.zh: 而且，目前这个空间正在进行大规模的翻新。

sentences.en: And for this project, to keep the costs affordable, they are reusing a lot of the features in the space, which, of course,
sentences.zh: 为了保持成本可控，他们正在重复利用空间里的许多设施，当然，

sentences.en: includes these two full-size boats from when it was the River Museum.
sentences.zh: 这包括了河博物馆时期的那两艘全尺寸船。

sentences.en: I know I'm a serious reporter, Roman, but I was not above ringing the bell and feeling delight at ringing the bell.
sentences.zh: 罗曼，我知道我是一名严肃的记者，但我还是忍不住去敲了敲钟，并为敲钟感到高兴。

sentences.en: But it's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: It's another reminder that I saw all over Memphis and that I really felt in the pyramid that the life of buildings is long, right?
sentences.zh: 这再次提醒了我，我在孟菲斯随处可见，在金字塔里也深有体会：建筑的生命是漫长的，对吧？

sentences.en: And we never know what's going to end up in a particular space.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不知道一个特定的空间最终会变成什么样。

sentences.en: I find it delightful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很令人愉悦。

sentences.en: In terms of adaptive reuse, it seems like an incredibly big change.
sentences.zh: 就适应性再利用而言，这似乎是一个巨大的变化。

sentences.en: Did Jimmy, our historian, you know, feel like the loss of something or just kind of excitement about what was happening?
sentences.zh: 我们的历史学家吉米（Jimmy），他是感到某种东西的流失，还是对正在发生的事情感到兴奋？

sentences.en: He's actually the one who brought me here.
sentences.zh: 其实是他带我来这里的。

sentences.en: So, he was enthusiastic that something was moving in, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，他对于有新事物入驻感到很兴奋，对吧？

sentences.en: And I feel like he had this really good attitude about how spaces change and how cities change.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他对于空间如何变化、城市如何变化，有着非常好的心态。

sentences.en: I mean, how do you feel seeing, like, knowing what it was and seeing what it's becoming like?
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你了解它曾经的样子，又看到它正在变成的样子，你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I'm over that.
sentences.zh: 我已经看开了。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, like when you have an old friend who passes away, you're sad for the passing, but it was a good long life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，就像当你的一位老朋友去世时，你会为他的离去感到悲伤，但他度过了美好而漫长的一生。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And after you get over the tears, you start telling stories about each other and it turns into a giggle fest at a funeral.
sentences.zh: 当你擦干眼泪后，你会开始讲述彼此的故事，葬礼反而变成了一场欢笑的聚会。

sentences.en: You know, it's a celebration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一种庆祝。

sentences.en: So, you know, to celebrate the 40 years that it was there, I feel like this is an attitude that sometimes I can lose sight of when talking about buildings and change in cities.
sentences.zh: 所以，为了庆祝它存在的那40年，我觉得这是一种我在谈论建筑和城市变迁时有时会忽略的心态。

sentences.en: And I just think this is a really healthy attitude to have.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这是一种非常健康的心态。

sentences.en: I think it's a great reminder for all of us about all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对我们所有人来说，都是关于各种事情的一个很好的提醒。

sentences.en: This is really fantastic, Chris.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒，克里斯。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for bringing me back to Memphis.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你带我回到孟菲斯。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: More than you know.
sentences.zh: 超乎你的想象。

sentences.en: Roman, it was a real pleasure.
sentences.zh: 罗曼，这真是一次愉快的经历。

sentences.en: And I hope one day they get the monorail running again.
sentences.zh: 我希望有一天他们能让单轨列车重新运行起来。

sentences.en: And I'd like to nominate us to be the first to take a ride on it because I really want to see the monorail in action.
sentences.zh: 我想提名我们成为第一批乘坐它的人，因为我真的很想亲眼看看单轨列车运行的样子。

sentences.zh: 我随时随地都会去那里和你汇合。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
